name: Outlaw Tools v0.11.0
body:
# Outlaw Tools v0.11.0

Public downloads for Outlaw Tools by Orbital Outlaws. Mining Scanner is the first complete module in the wider companion app.

Product home: https://www.orbitaloutlaws.tv/

Source repository: private (PattrnData/Outlaw-Tools)

# Outlaw Tools v0.11.0

## Easier Setup

- Home now offers Game setup & data status. The Settings navigation explains that it contains game data, updates, sync and scanner controls, using the existing app styling.

## Reference Coverage

- Refresh bundled mining references and the paired Blueprint/mission catalogs from reviewed dataset revisions. Add 11 Blueprint entries and a distinct Carinite (Pure) reference; retain existing resource/Blueprint identities. The mission source adds two entries and removes eight obsolete Orison Relief references; player history is retained.
- Extend the existing staged update/proposal pipeline to all six reference bundles and SQLite, with validation and rollback. Reject conflicting joined dataset versions.
- Keep family-only Blueprint/mission builds and undeclared signature builds explicit. A launcher manifest cannot certify a dataset's build, including in older cached metadata.

## Local Data

- Reference builders reuse pure mining adapters without starting the app or opening player data. No player-data migration, runtime dependency or new background downloader.

## Downloads

- Windows installer and Linux x86_64 archive, with SHA-256 checksums.
